item.title: Digital Transformation and Service
item.content:encoded:
Christian Bartelheimer, University of Göttingen

Daniel Beverungen, Paderborn University

Sara Hofmann, University of Agder

Lysanne Lessard, University of Ottawa

This topical collection examines how digital technologies reshape organizational value creation through a service lens. The collection seeks research that integrates digital transformation and service perspectives within information systems, moving beyond surface-level claims to investigate how IT artifacts fundamentally enable, constrain, or transform service exchange and value co-creation across organizational boundaries, platforms, and ecosystems.

The collection welcomes diverse research methodologies including design science, qualitative studies, quantitative research, and literature reviews. Studies are particularly encouraged to examine real-world service scenarios in inter-organizational contexts such as service networks, digital platforms, and business ecosystems, with attention to how digital technologies shape customer relations, value propositions, and service delivery.
